# Puzzle continuity, publication and baseline standard — 5 September 2026

**Control:** `PD-PUZZLE-CONTINUITY-20260905-01`  
**Scope:** `/en/puzzle/`, `/es/puzzle/`, their evidence assets, all reverse links and all future worker/integrator handoffs.

## Controlling hierarchy

1. **25 June 2026 NEXUS 36 filing** — canonical filed factual/narrative baseline. It is a party pleading, not a judicial merits finding.
2. **20/21 July 2026 Puzzle companion for DP 1956/2026 and DP 1901/2026** — later procedural lens. The proceedings remain separate and are never silently merged.
3. **PUZZLE 2024, 32 pages** — historic visual exhibit. Historic accusation language is not silently promoted into the current evidential conclusion.
4. **Current primary documents and official outcomes** — control present propositions and can confirm, qualify or contradict older formulations.

## Publication contract

The Puzzle may never fail silently. If the archival 50,046,618-byte master is not a practical web payload, the public interface must use a source-derived 32-page web-reading derivative and disclose that it is a derivative. It must provide a direct download control, an all-pages overview image download, page navigation, deep links, fit/zoom, responsive layouts and a visible source-integrity statement.

The archival master is identified by SHA-256 `e441bdb368c0092d5b15ca5ee911eeac266540bde54817e424f3075f4c5fdd47`. A public derivative must have its own hash and must never be labelled byte-identical to the master.

No synthetic or reconstructed visual may be substituted as evidence. Contact sheets, thumbnails, OCR and compressed PDFs must be generated from the authenticated original and labelled as derivatives.

## External-device acceptance

Before publication, test EN and ES at minimum at desktop 1440x900, phone 390x844 and tablet 820x1180. Test initial load, page 10 deep link, previous/next, direct page entry, zoom/fit, download controls, keyboard navigation and no horizontal overflow. Fullscreen can be tested only to the extent supported by the browser/automation environment.

## Evidential language

Every proposition must distinguish: documented fact; attributed representation; claimant allegation; provisional inference; open verification question; official outcome; judicial finding. Chronology, association, common adviser, common lender, family link, common firm or shared proceeding does not by itself prove knowledge, intent, causation, control, benefit or criminal participation.

## Public funds and tax incentives

For this control, **public funds** means the evidenced or properly investigable national, regional or EU public-funding perimeter; the label does not itself establish receipt, misuse or an offence.

The Puzzle must make the public-interest perimeter visible where evidence supports inquiry into tax incentives, subsidies, grants or national/regional/EU funds. It may ask whether third-party units, rooms, jobs, assets or rights were improperly or over-broadly included in eligibility, valuation, financing or benefit calculations. It must not state an autonomous subsidy-fraud or EU-financial-interests finding until the grant, beneficiary, declaration, eligibility criteria, award, amount, funding source, eligible expenditure and causal link are evidenced.

## Informant / investor status

The site may state that the 25 June filing describes Gil Marer as an informant/alertador who has communicated matters to Spanish and European authorities since 2021, and describes Aweswell Limited as a UK foreign investor in Spain. It must state that Spanish Law 2/2023/EU protection is conditional on statutory scope and requirements. German or UK statutory protection must be framed as conditional on the necessary German or UK factual/professional/legal nexus; citizenship or investment ownership alone is insufficient.

## Interlinkability

Every material actor/entity/proceeding/evidence object must have forward and reverse links where a public route exists. The Puzzle must expose at least: LPB; Aweswell; Matkator; Concurso 36/2012; private-actor/CAM perimeter; Insolvency Administrator; judicial perimeter; Bankia; SAREB; HAYA; PH122; Cerberus context; CaixaBank; Uría and identified lawyers; RICPE; PwC; San Telmo; public-authority/public-funds perimeter; Controls/DP tracks; and current production/preservation questions.

Edges have statuses. An edge never transfers knowledge, intent or liability.

## Continuity governance

Workers prepare deltas; one active integrator owns publication. Every handoff records base SHA, head SHA, affected routes, source/hash controls, unresolved binaries, inherited CI debt and whether public readback was actually performed. Corrections supersede; they do not erase the prior source or its historical status. A successful Pages deployment is not equivalent to verified route/device/download functionality.
